svg.title: OneGrid regional failover sequence
svg.desc: Declare, fence, recover, rebind, gate, cut over, observe and reconcile, with the numbered steps of the recovery procedure and the failure mode that fencing prevents.

g.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Declare, fence, recover, rebind, gate, cut over, observe and reconcile, with the numbered steps of the recovery procedure and the failure mode that fencing prevents.
Workflow step; numbers match the article
a. Two publishers: the older run can win.
b. Two replays: the same events twice.
d. Enable the recovery job last (6).
Numbers match the Fail over procedure in the multiregion article and repeat in the inset where a step guards that path.
